reader_summary.overview: A note about this show: we recorded this episode the night before the 2016 Election Day in the US. At the time, the biggest change we saw coming was adding a new type of content to Acquired in analyzing IPO’s. Two days later, we woke up to a very different world than the one we were expecting.
